name: Helfgrim's Blades
desc1: This is an orderly shop. It is obvious what it sells, as swords of all
desc2: description hang from the walls, are displayed on racks, and can be
desc3: seen in cases in the middle of the floor. A well-built man stands
desc4: behind a wooden counter, and as you enter, he nods curtly and gestures
desc5: towards his wares. You can exit through the doorway to the east.
desc7: shop through the door to the east.
